# Mathematical notation

Adopt the [mathematical notation](../../standard/foundations/mathematical-notation.md) for needs, requirements, systems and processes; their contextual representation and contribution relationships; part, dependency and process-participation statements; and separate requirement results, extent of achievement and need judgments.

Retain the explained meanings of context and assessment basis, the distinction between intended contribution and supported results, the non-automatic inference from requirement to need fulfillment, and environment-chosen handling of raised ambiguity. Adopt the worked report-review cases and readable-section illustration as explanations of the notation, not as empirical evidence.
